title: iOverlander Camp Spot Event Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ioverlander:place
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(place_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many iOverlander camp spot event events land each day and how many distinct place name values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest iOverlander camp spot event records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct place name values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much iOverlander camp spot event activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
